contrary_evidence: US equities fell sharply as constant-maturity Treasury yields also fell; a nominal bond rally cannot be attributed to a Fed policy cut on Nov 5.
Brent futures rose 3.88% after their Nov 4 8.67% drop, but independently verified physical oil cargo deficits were not measured.
A technology equity-market sell-off does not prove that AI capital expenditure, data-center projects or output have already declined.
BoE raised Bank Rate to 4.00 while Brazil held Selic at 13.75 and US Treasury yields declined; monetary stances are not synchronized.
Euro-area October flash headline inflation 4.0 and Chinese manufacturing PMI 49.3 show cost and demand pressures that do not move together.
An ADP October private-job report is not equivalent to official BLS nonfarm payrolls due Nov 6.
limitations: Information cutoff is 6 November 2026 00:07 BRT; no claim of observed November 6 US payrolls or later market closes.
Semiconductor index change approximately -12.2%, rounded; primary stock index closes taken from AP and Reuters.
US Treasury constant-maturity yields are indicative par curves, not executed central bank policy rates.
Brent/WTI price observations are futures settlements and do not measure physical oil delivered or war-risk insurance costs.
Shipping attacks are reported and attributed within source accounts, not independently forensically verified case-by-case.
Bank of England mid-2027 inflation estimate is forecast, not realized inflation; Eurostat October HICP is flash.
China official PMI surveys are diffusion data, not industrial output-growth percentages.
Sources observed during assisted preparation; independent QA and public deployment have not occurred at producer stage.
Same assisted workflow performed source preparation and evidence review; not independent human fact-check or a completed CI build.
